english.title: Make false statement to induce local housing authority to believe entitlement to accommodation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to induce a local housing authority to believe in connection with the exercise of its functions under Chapter 2 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014 that

(A)_[you were]_
(B)_[another person, namely **(.. SPECIFY PERSON..), was]_

entitled to accommodation or assistance

(C)_[in accordance with the provisions of that Chapter,]_
(D)_[of a particular description,]_

knowingly or recklessly made a statement which was false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97(1)(a) and (6) of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.
